function.arguments: {"answer": "The email campaign improved conversion rates compared to paid search, with an adjusted difference in conversion rates of 0.0117 (email minus paid_search), after accounting for confounding by customer segment.", "value": 0.011722122261636022, "method": "The 'converted' column was found to be inconsistent with the definition of conversion as a completed purchase, as it includes refunded orders and excludes completed ones. The raw difference in conversion rates was confounded by customer segment imbalance: the email campaign had a higher proportion of loyal and returning customers, who have higher conversion rates.
